trade_scope: UN Comtrade HS 8542 semiconductor trade evidence
icio_scope: OECD ICIO C26 computer, electronic and optical products

country_matching.rule: Match trade country/area ISO alpha-3 codes exactly to OECD ICIO country codes when identical. No fuzzy name matching and no manual reassignment after results are inspected.
exclude_from_match: Other Asia, nes and other residual/special trade areas without an exact ICIO country code
trade reporters or suppliers without an exact C26 ICIO node
ICIO aggregate/rest-of-world codes without an exact trade country/area counterpart
country_matching.taiwan_rule: Do not map Other Asia, nes (Comtrade code 490 / ISO S19) to TWN. Any Taiwan comparison requires a separately justified exact mapping and is outside this confirmatory comparison.

comparison_pairs.name: export_scale
comparison_pairs.trade_measure: exporter-reported HS 8542 World export value for each positive matched exporter
comparison_pairs.icio_measure: C26 foreign_intermediate_sales for the same matched country
comparison_pairs.normalization: Ranks are primary. Value shares within the matched sample may be reported secondarily, but raw monetary levels are not treated as directly equivalent across datasets.

comparison_pairs.name: downstream_importance
comparison_pairs.trade_measure: sum across the frozen 84 material importers of each named supplier's importer-reported HS 8542 partner_share; call this trade_downstream_share_mass
comparison_pairs.icio_measure: C26 foreign_downstream_input_share_mass for the same matched country
comparison_pairs.normalization: Ranks are primary. The two masses are dimensionless but arise from different systems and are not interpreted as equal quantities.

statistics.primary: Spearman rank correlation for each comparison pair over the exact matched-country set
secondary: rank difference = trade rank minus ICIO rank
top-10 overlap count and Jaccard index when at least 10 matched countries exist
statistics.ties: Use average ranks for Spearman calculation; deterministic displayed rankings sort descending by measure then ascending by country code.
statistics.missingness: Report matched and excluded counts explicitly. Do not impute missing trade or ICIO measures.

mirror_boundary: Mirror-audit results remain a data-quality diagnostic only. Do not replace, average or correct importer-reported or exporter-reported trade values before the ICIO comparison.
interpretation: This is a descriptive cross-system rank comparison, not validation of either dataset.
HS 8542 is narrower than ICIO C26.
Trade routing and re-exports may generate large discrepancies between commercial trade prominence and production-network importance.
No causal inference, fabrication-origin claim, technological-dependence claim or composite vulnerability score is permitted.
scientific_boundary: The comparison design is frozen after the importer, exporter and mirror evidence is complete but before any HS8542-versus-C26 cross-dataset correlation or rank-difference result is calculated.
